note: Messages of published sets (0.6.0). Filled in by the code: {who} {names} {guid} {line} {presets}.

messages.setUnknown: No published set has that name; the published sets are {names}

messages.setNeedsKeys: `--set` can be used only with `--blind-keys`, because a set is always blind
messages.setNotBlind: {who}: a set is always blind; it needs the blind option and a separate folder for its answer keys
messages.setOptions: {who}: a set fixes its types, scenarios, seeds, seed prefix, degraded preset, 835 and layout variant, so none of them can be given with it
messages.manifestDegradation: manifest line {line} has a degradation that is neither null nor one of the presets: {presets}
messages.scoreRows: set scoring needs every document to have a type given as text and a degradation that is null or one of the presets
